steps.title: FAQ: Extra costs
steps.text:
Costs beyond the price When you buy ▫️ Transfer tax: 4% ▫️ Lawyer: $500* ▫️ Title transfer fee: depends on the project While you own it ▫️ Property tax: 0.1% a year on the value above about $25,000 ▫️ Building management: $1 to $2 per sqm a month ▫️ Rental management: 5% to 10% of the rent ▫️ Rental income tax: 14% if you live abroad, 10% if resident When you sell ▫️ Capital gains tax: 20% of the gain, scheduled from January 2027, may change Depends on the project ▫️ Furniture: some units come furnished *The usual fee in Cambodia. It depends on the lawyer, and a Japanese lawyer may cost more.
The booking fee and down payment are part of the price, not extra costs.
Some developers pay the transfer tax as a promotion. Nick confirms the figures for each project.

steps.title: FAQ: How buying works
steps.text:
The buying process: 6 steps ① Booking: fee of $500 to $2,000 ② Down payment and contract: 20% to 30% ③ Instalments: during construction ④ Balance: 40% to 50% at handover ⑤ Handover: inspect the unit, collect the keys ⑥ Title: registered in your name
The steps are almost always the same. What changes is the amount and timing of each payment.
Ask Nick for the plan of a specific project.
steps.note: Facts from the website FAQ. Japanese needs a native review. Khmer shows English for now.

jp.t:
購入の流れ（6ステップ） ① 予約：予約金 500ドルから2,000ドル ② 頭金と契約：価格の20%から30% ③ 分割払い：建設中に支払い ④ 残金：引き渡し時に40%から50% ⑤ 引き渡し：部屋を点検して鍵を受け取り ⑥ 登記：ご本人の名義に
手順はほぼ共通です。違うのは、各段階の金額と期間です。
物件ごとの支払い計画はLINEでお伝えします。

The steps are almost always the same. What changes is the amount and timing of each payment.
Ask Nick for the plan of a specific project.
b: និយាយជាមួយ Nick តាម Telegram
ត្រឡប់ក្រោយ

steps.title: FAQ: Buying from abroad
steps.text:
You can buy from abroad ① Online: choosing the unit, questions and transfers ② Contract: signed by hand on the originals (no e-signature) ③ Courier: originals go by DHL or similar, and the developer or seller signs them too
A power of attorney is also possible, but the process is more involved.
Prices and rents are usually in US dollars.
steps.note: Facts from the website FAQ. Japanese needs a native review. Khmer shows English for now.

jp.t:
海外からでも購入できます ① オンライン：物件選び、ご相談、送金まで ② 契約書：原本に手書きで署名（電子署名は不可） ③ 国際宅配便：DHLなどで原本を送り、デベロッパーや売主も署名します
委任状による購入も可能ですが、手続きが複雑になります。
価格と家賃は、通常、米ドルで取引されます。

steps.title: Check a listing for me
steps.text: Check a listing for me Found something online? Send the link, a screenshot or your own calculation. Nick will tell you what to check before you go further.
steps.note: In the bot this step moves on when the client sends a link or a photo. The button only lets you play it here.

jp.t: 物件のチェックを依頼 他のサイトで気になる物件を見つけましたか？リンク、スクリーンショット、またはご自身の計算をお送りください。購入を進める前に確認すべき点をNickがお伝えします。

kh.t: ពិនិត្យបញ្ជីអចលនទ្រព្យឱ្យខ្ញុំ រកឃើញអ្វីមួយនៅលើអ៊ីនធឺណិតឬ? សូមផ្ញើតំណ ឬរូបថតអេក្រង់។ Nick នឹងប្រាប់អ្នកថាគួរពិនិត្យអ្វីមុនពេលបន្ត។
b: ត្រឡប់ក្រោយ

steps.title: Listing received
steps.text: Received. Nick will review it and reply within 1 business day.
steps.note: Creates a lead with the link or photo attached.

jp.t: 受け取りました。Nickが内容を確認し、1営業日以内にご返信いたします。

kh.t: បានទទួលហើយ។ Nick នឹងពិនិត្យ ហើយឆ្លើយតបក្នុងរយៈពេល 1 ថ្ងៃធ្វើការ។

steps.title: Estimate with my numbers
steps.text: Estimate with my numbers Three short questions, then you see what you keep each year. ① What is the price? (USD) Example: 68000 You can also send all three at once: price, rent, size, like 68000 650 35
steps.note: The client types the numbers. The bot supplies no yield figure of its own.

jp.t: ご自身の数値で試算 3つの質問のあと、年間の手取りが分かります。 ① 物件の価格は？（ドル） 例：68000 価格、家賃、広さの3つをまとめて 68000 650 35 と送ることもできます。

kh.t: Estimate with my numbers Three short questions, then you see what you keep each year. ① What is the price? (USD) Example: 68000 You can also send all three at once: price, rent, size, like 68000 650 35

steps.title: Estimate: my own calculation
steps.text: Send your own calculation Send it as it is, as text or a screenshot. Nick checks it and replies within 1 business day. Example: Time Square 5 Rent $500 a month Building fee $1 per sqm Size 50 sqm
steps.note: Whatever the client sends is forwarded to Nick with a draft check (engines/estimate.js). Nothing goes back to the client until Nick taps Send.

kh.t: ការប៉ាន់ស្មានរបស់អ្នក ផ្អែកលើលេខដែលអ្នកបានផ្ញើតែប៉ុណ្ណោះ ថ្លៃជួលប្រចាំឆ្នាំ: $[amount] ចំណាយប្រចាំឆ្នាំ: $[amount] ប្រាក់ចំណូលសុទ្ធ: $[amount] អត្រាផលសុទ្ធ: [result] ភាគរយ ទិន្នផល និងតម្លៃគឺជាតម្លៃយោងប៉ុណ្ណោះ ហើយមិនធានាប្រាក់ចំណូលនាពេលអនាគតទេ។
b: សុំ Nick ពិនិត្យ
សាកល្បងលេខផ្សេង

steps.title: Privacy and my data
steps.text: Privacy and my data We store your Telegram ID, your language, your answers and the topics and units you look at, so Nick can help you. When you ask about a unit, request the guide or book a tour, your name and these interests are saved in Nick's client list. We do not sell or share them. You can delete everything at any time.
steps.note: Needs a quick legal read for clients in the EU and Japan.

jp.t: プライバシーとデータ Nickがご相談に対応するため、TelegramのID、言語、ご回答内容、ご覧になったテーマと物件を保存します。物件へのお問い合わせ、資料のご請求、内覧のご予約をいただいた場合は、お名前とこれらの内容をNickの顧客リストに記録します。第三者への販売や共有は行いません。 データはいつでも削除できます。

kh.t: ឯកជនភាព និងទិន្នន័យរបស់ខ្ញុំ យើងរក្សាទុក Telegram ID ភាសា ចម្លើយរបស់អ្នក និងប្រធានបទ និងបន្ទប់ដែលអ្នកបានមើល ដើម្បីឱ្យ Nick អាចជួយអ្នកបាន។ នៅពេលអ្នកសួរអំពីបន្ទប់ ស្នើសុំឯកសារ ឬកក់ពេលទស្សនា ឈ្មោះរបស់អ្នក និងព័ត៌មានទាំងនេះនឹងត្រូវកត់ត្រាក្នុងបញ្ជីអតិថិជនរបស់ Nick។ យើងមិនលក់ ឬចែករំលែកវាទេ។ អ្នកអាចលុបទាំងអស់បានគ្រប់ពេល។

steps.text: Delete my data This removes your saved searches, new listing alerts and enquiry history. Tap Confirm to delete.
